entities.name: vibe coding
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成：一种凭直觉、不写传统代码的业余编程方式。Replit 的中位数用户就是这类人群(vibe coder)；公司内部也招了极小的全职 vibe coder 团队，用 Replit 自己造出客服、HR 等能产生实质影响的内部工具。

evidence.quote: I love to talk about them because oftentimes people think that vibe coding is just creating like a small set project.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 基于用量的计费 (usage-based billing)
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成：AI 时代的定价开拓模型。因为无法预测一个智能体跑完一个具体任务要多久，固定定价或纯订阅无法规模化，智能体本质上必须按使用量(消耗的计算量或 token)成比例收费。

evidence.quote: So we embrace usage-based billing very, very early.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 部署 (deployment)
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成：Replit 最痴迷、也最独有的一项关键业务指标。当用户愿意为了把构建的东西发布上网而花更多钱时，这比任何点赞或反馈都更能说明问题，标志着用户认可了「有价值的工作单元」。

evidence.quote: I think something that is very peculiar to Replit, because again, we care about the software creation lifecycle end-to-end, is the fact that we also have a deployment product.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: what our agent is doing correctly or some of the bugs that we have, I always put more emphasis on the agent traces that brought us to a deployment rather than those who didn't, because I know that that's what a user considers end-to-end work.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 人物角色 (persona)
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成：产品设计中虚构的典型用户画像(如「为产品经理优化」)。Replit 的产品哲学明确拒绝谈人物角色，而是寻找每个知识工作者都绕不开的极简原语，因为「一个好产品在一个庞大的用户群体中都是好的」。

evidence.quote: We don't try to tailor it towards a specific type of persona.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And one of the principles we follow internally is to, I don't want to hear the word persona during a meeting, basically.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: So in your product development process, are you looking for the things that every knowledge worker needs across every persona versus like, hey, here's the thing specifically that a PM needs or specifically that a designer needs?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 一人独角兽公司 (one-person unicorn)
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成：一个人靠指挥和编排一堆 AI，做出估值十亿美元公司的设想。嘉宾认为虽然逻辑上竞争会逼着公司雇人，停在 2.5 亿美元 ARR，但凭一个产品愿景、用最少资源也能做到这件事依然令人激动。

evidence.quote: You're a big proponent of the one-person billion-dollar company, the one-person unicorn.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 产品市场契合 (product market fit)
entities.how_described: 本集提到：Replit 早期难以变现，直到 Replit Agent 发布并真正达到产品市场契合后，公司命运才彻底改变。

evidence.quote: I think it's always very interesting how companies think about when to invest in a bet and structure their teams around a bet or something that they don't know is going to work versus when to continue investing in the thing that maybe it's not full product market fit, but it seems to be working in some sense.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And I never experienced that again, because since the launch, when we actually hit product market fit, my life changed completely.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: OpenAI
entities.how_described: 本集顺带提到：大厂研究员的心态往往对模型有多好、产品体验有多精致有预设的期待，带着「研究员的枷锁」；此外 Replit 早期接触的首批 token 源模型包括来自 OpenAI 的 GPT-2。

evidence.quote: when we got access to the first token source models like GPT-2 from OpenAI.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And I think I can put myself in the shoes of researchers that were at OpenAI and Anthropic in those days, where you always have certain expectations in terms of how good your model has to be, how good is the product experience that you want to launch.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: Anthropic
entities.how_described: 本集顺带提到：与 OpenAI 一起被提及，作为大厂研究员代表，其研究人员对模型效果和产品体验往往有固有的高标准与预设期待。

evidence.quote: And I think I can put myself in the shoes of researchers that were at OpenAI and Anthropic in those days, where you always have certain expectations in terms of how good your model has to be, how good is the product experience that you want to launch.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: Stripe
entities.how_described: 本集提到：一家支付处理服务商。Replit 在去年第四季度上线了 Stripe 集成，让用户能直接在应用里收钱，该功能增速惊人。此外 Stripe Atlas 服务还能自动化注册一家 LLC。

evidence.quote: Now, in order to make payments easier, of course, the first area that we explored was the Stripe integration that we work on together in the last few months.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: So the zero to MVP and the basic steps required to run a business, like including incorporating an LLC with Stripe Atlas, all of that can be easily automated.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01
